title: Strict-front A-pose character sheet
description: The workhorse sheet: dead-on front, A-pose, white background, orthographic framing.

body.subject: A clean character reference sheet of {{character_description}}, full body visible from head to toe, standing in a relaxed A-pose, matching the character's identity, proportions, colour palette and accessories exactly from the reference image.
body.action: Arms angled about 45 degrees down-and-out from the torso, palms facing the camera, fingers relaxed; legs shoulder-width apart, weight even on both feet, toes pointing forward at the camera; eyes looking at the camera.
body.camera: STRICT FRONT VIEW: the character faces the camera dead-on, no three-quarter angle, no rotation, no tilt of the body; both shoulders at equal width, both feet equally visible; eye-level, orthographic-style framing, zero perspective distortion.
body.style: Pure white background (#FFFFFF), no shadow on the ground, no ground plane; neutral diffuse studio lighting, soft and even, no rim light, no side key, no coloured gels; sharp focus over the whole silhouette, reference-grade clarity at 2K.
body.constraints: Preserve the face identity. If the model returns a three-quarter view, retry with stronger STRICT FRONT language; after three attempts escalate to the user and never ship a three-quarter sheet.

character_description.default: the character in the reference image
character_description.description: gender presentation if obvious, apparent age, art style, key wardrobe, key accessories, colour palette

negatives: no environment, shadow or rim lighting
